tricks.title: Multiply by 11
tricks.explanation: For a two-digit number, add its digits and place the sum between them. Carry if the sum is 10 or more.

steps: Keep 2 and 3 as the outside digits.
Add 2 + 3 = 5 and put it in the middle.

tricks.title: Numbers Ending in 5 Squared
tricks.explanation: Multiply the digits before the 5 by the next whole number, then finish with 25.

tricks.title: Complements to 100
tricks.explanation: Find how much is needed to reach the next ten, then how much remains to reach 100.

tricks.title: Fast Percentages
tricks.explanation: Build useful percentages from 10%, 5%, and 1%. Ten percent is the number divided by ten.

steps: 5% is half of 10%, so it is 4.

tricks.title: Near-Base Multiplication
tricks.explanation: When both numbers are near 100, use their distances from 100 to simplify the multiplication.

steps: Multiply the shortfalls: 3 x 4 = 12. Join 93 and 12.
